document_title: Endocrine Treatment of Gender-Dysphoric/Gender-Incongruent Persons: An Endocrine Society Clinical Practice Guideline
source_notes: Endocrine Society clinical practice guideline published in 2017. The document addresses prepubertal youth, adolescents, and adults; only adult-specific in-scope monitoring recommendations will be included in this audit. Geographic applicability is not explicitly stated. Two official corrigenda were identified. Corrigendum DOI 10.1210/jc.2017-02548 corrects the injectable-testosterone wording in Table 14, item 2a, and must be applied during later recommendation extraction. Corrigendum DOI 10.1210/jc.2018-01268 corrects Recommendation 1.1 and a bone-health citation and does not alter the identified in-scope estradiol or testosterone monitoring passages. The 2017 guideline explicitly updates the Endocrine Society’s 2009 guideline; the predecessor relationship is documented, but upstream-source registration remains unresolved.
